title: Ifa Barnootaa - The Light of Education

shots.image_prompt: A beautiful Ethiopian rural landscape at sunrise, a small village, warm golden sunlight, cinematic documentary style.
shots.motion_prompt: Slow cinematic camera movement across the village toward the rising sun.
shots.narration: Barnoonni jireenya namaa keessatti ifa guddaa dha.

shots.image_prompt: A fictional Ethiopian school student preparing books and notebooks at home, warm natural lighting, cinematic realism.
shots.motion_prompt: Slow camera push toward the student preparing school materials.
shots.narration: Dargaggeessi tokko abjuu guddaa fi abdii cimaa qaba.
shots.music_cue: Gentle piano and traditional instrumental texture.

shots.image_prompt: A fictional Ethiopian student walking along a rural path toward school, green countryside, morning light, cinematic wide composition.
shots.motion_prompt: Gentle tracking shot following the student walking toward school.
shots.narration: Guyyaa guyyaan, barachuuf karaa dheeraa deema.

shots.image_prompt: An Ethiopian teacher teaching students in a modest classroom, students listening attentively, warm daylight, realistic cinematic style.
shots.motion_prompt: Slow pan across the classroom toward the teacher.
shots.narration: Barsiisaan gaariin beekumsa qofa osoo hin taane abdii kenna.

shots.image_prompt: Close-up of a student's hands writing in a notebook beside textbooks, natural window light, cinematic detail.
shots.motion_prompt: Slow close-up movement across the notebook and writing hand.
shots.narration: Barataan kun dubbisuu, barreessuu fi gaaffii gaafachuu barataa jira.

shots.image_prompt: A fictional Ethiopian family encouraging a young student at home, caring expressions, simple home environment, warm cinematic lighting.
shots.motion_prompt: Gentle camera movement showing the family supporting the student.
shots.narration: Maatiin isaa isa jajjabeessa; hawaasnis milkaa'ina isaa deeggera.

shots.image_prompt: A determined student studying at a wooden desk in the evening under a small lamp, books open, cinematic atmosphere.
shots.motion_prompt: Slow camera push toward the focused student and open books.
shots.narration: Rakkoon yoo jiraate illee, abdii isaa hin dhiisu.
shots.music_cue: Music gradually builds with quiet determination.

shots.image_prompt: A student standing near a school doorway looking toward a bright future, sunlight entering the school, cinematic hopeful composition.
shots.motion_prompt: Slow camera movement from the student toward the bright doorway.
shots.narration: Beekumsi karaa haaraa fi carraa haaraa namaaf bana.

shots.image_prompt: A young educated Ethiopian person helping community members in a village, positive community interaction, realistic cinematic style.
shots.motion_prompt: Slow cinematic pan showing the student helping members of the community.
shots.narration: Namni barate maatii isaa fi hawaasa isaa gargaaruu danda'a.

shots.image_prompt: Beautiful sunset over an Ethiopian school and village, students walking together, hopeful cinematic ending, space for closing title.
shots.motion_prompt: Slow pull-back from the school into a warm sunset, ending with a gentle fade.
shots.narration: Barnoonni ifa egeree ti. Egaa, barnoota haa deeggaru.
shots.music_cue: Emotional musical resolution and gentle fade.
